### A Seal on the Heart and Arm
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/seal-heart-and-arm
Passage: Song of Solomon 8:6-7
Points:
- Ancient wax seals served as permanent marks of authenticity and ownership.
- The bride's request represents mutual, selfless devotion where each spouse gives themselves to the other without exploitation.
- Placing the seal upon both heart and arm symbolizes an embrace encompassing inner affections, thoughts, and outward actions.
- Marital jealousy is presented as a protective virtue guarding the sacred exclusivity of the marriage covenant.
- The flame of love carries godlike intensity and endurance, reflecting the Lord's profound love for His people.
